# 先 … 再 … / … 先 · *sin1 … zoi3 … / … sin1*

**Meaning:** first …, then … · **Level:** B1 · **Topic:** Connecting words

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fsin1-zoi3-first-then).

先 means 'first' and 再 'then'. Very typically for Cantonese, 先 can also come at the end of a sentence: 等我諗吓先 (let me think first).

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我哋先食飯，再去睇戲。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 dei6 sin1 sik6 faan6, zoi3 heoi3 tai2 hei3. |
| Yale | ngóh deih sīn sihk faahn, joi heui tái hei. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄉㄝㄧ⁶ ㄙㄧㄣ¹ ㄙㄧㆶ⁶ ㄈㄚㄣ⁶, ㄗㄛㄧ³ ㄏㆤㄧ³ ㄊㄜㄧ² ㄏㄝㄧ³. |
| English | Let's eat first, then go to the cinema. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你先做功課，再玩啦。** |
| Jyutping | nei5 sin1 zou6 gung1 fo3, zoi3 waan2 laa1. |
| Yale | néih sīn jouh gūng fo, joi wáan lā. |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄙㄧㄣ¹ ㄗㄛㄨ⁶ ㄍㄨㄥ¹ ㄈㄛ³, ㄗㄛㄧ³ ㄨㄚㄣ² ㄌㄚ¹. |
| English | Do your homework first, then play. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **等我諗吓先。** |
| Jyutping | dang2 ngo5 nam2 haa5 sin1. |
| Yale | dáng ngóh nám háh sīn. |
| Bopomofo | ㄉㄜㄥ² ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄋㄜㆬ² ㄏㄚ⁵ ㄙㄧㄣ¹. |
| English | Let me think about it first. |
